finalZipVerification.proofScope: Every original served asset byte, before the checker-only observation hook, matches the frozen stage and the exact release ZIP. Authored PCM matches original WASM/parser reference at unity gain.

postDocsCaptureChanges: Only JSDoc sampleRate parameter annotations and a Native-only expected-control-rejection message were added before the final flat captures.
Final Native Rust admission now silences the previous score during a future start and rejects out-of-range end frames.

limits: Automatic Browser capture zeroed physical output; human listening and Atari hardware comparison were not performed.
Import accepts POKEY-only streams and plays one pass; no source loop repetition or instrument reconstruction.
44100-Hz VGM samples map directly to output frames with ceil; 48-kHz rendering is not Analyzer 44.1-kHz audio resampled afterward.

Browser preparation still scans/copies the complete trace on its Worklet thread; a warm local Node check took about 32–35 ms at 8 MiB. Preparing large scores during another performance can interrupt its audio. Generated imports finish preparing before starting.
Public npm tetorica-fm2612 0.2.30 does not include POKEY. The retained tarball is an unpublished local candidate.
